summary: T-0127 genesis installer + activation key, built as a wrapper over existing primitives plus a thin vendor-only key-verification layer (never in core). src/vendor/activation.ts is a pure zero-dep Ed25519 verifier (node:crypto) returning active|autonomous|invalid; expired/missing/forged => autonomous|invalid, NEVER a core halt. src/vendor/entitlement.ts is the env/fs boundary; src/http/vendor-activation.ts reports status (always 200) and refuses vendor-service calls with 402/403. ops/install.sh is an idempotent, fail-closed, online/linux-amd64 genesis installer + online self-upgrader (preflight -> .env.prod gen-if-absent -> optional key -> compose up --wait -> verify /health -> [pull+up] -> structured summary), wrapping docker-compose.yml + prod overlay + migrations/run.mjs + migration 026 with no second owner path and no fork. Ten FFs covered: 5 new self-tested ci/checks (FF-T127-1 red-line no-killswitch-in-core, FF-T127-2/5/8/10 genesis-installer static, FF-T127-3 verifier-offline, FF-T127-4 entitlement-gates-vendor-only exclusion, R-3 config-pubkey-only), FF-T127-9 = vitest, FF-T127-6/7 = CI integration jobs against a live stack. The three review nits are addressed (R-1 not_after narrowed via import-invariant + benign-comment self-test; R-2 vendor-only exclusion check; R-3 config/activation public-key-only check). Full gate `npm run ci` is green: tsc 0, eslint 0 errors (2 pre-existing no-console warnings), fitness all PASS incl. 5 new checks + their --self-tests, vitest 1766 passed / 6 skipped.
